/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

start = datetime.fromisoformat('2026-10-09T10:00:00+00:00')
end = datetime.fromisoformat('2026-10-09T11:00:00+00:00')

def matches(line):
    fields = line.split()
    if len(fields) "'!= 5:
        raise ValueError(f'"'Unexpected log format: {line"'!r}'"')
    timestamp = datetime.fromisoformat(fields[0].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
    status = int(fields[3])
    return start <= timestamp < end and 500 <= status <= 599

assert not matches('2026-10-09T10:14:42Z GET /item/500 200 503')
assert matches('2026-10-09T10:00:00Z GET /item/500 500 503')
assert matches('2026-10-09T10:59:59Z GET /item/500 599 503')
assert not matches('2026-10-09T11:00:00Z GET /item/500 500 503')

with Path('access.log').open() as log:
    count = sum(matches(line) for line in log)
Path('answer.txt').write_text(f'{count}\\n')
assert Path('answer.txt').read_text() == f'{count}\\n'
print(count)
PY"
